messages:
Noah: anyone else in the building just lose internet? mid-standup my Zoom froze and then poof. thunderstorm outside though.
Priya: yep same. ISP status shows a "service disruption" for my metro. :cloud_with_lightning:
Zoe: going old-school 90s 6054f64bb3fb. packing up and hunting a cafe. who wants coffee? :coffee:
Luis: travel router + LTE SIM here. pro tip: enable NAT and set DNS to 1.1.1.1 to speed things up.
Noah: I have a spare travel router too but forgot the PoE injector for the office AP. anyone want my desk for hotspot rescue?
Priya: @Noah I'll come by if you don't mind sharing your sacrificial ethernet cable. I'll bring gummy bears. :grin:
InfraBot: NOC alert: elevated packet loss detected in us-east-1 and us-east-2, suspected fiber cut due to weather. ETA unknown.
Noah: thanks @InfraBot. good to know it's not just me.
Zoe: quick poll: what's your emergency power/internet stack? 1) phone hotspot, 2) travel router + SIM, 3) battery + tether, 4) go to coworking/cafe. React with 1/2/3/4.
Luis: 2 here. also keep a small battery pack with pass-through charging, saved my day last month.
Priya: 4 for me when it's daytime, 1 at night.
Noah: 3. I use my laptop as hotspot sometimes but the battery drains fast.
Zoe: 1s and 4s mostly. also, home tip: keep a cheap surge protector and unplug the modem during big lightning storms. saved router once.
Priya: agreed. also if your modem is in a closet, run a long ethernet to a window area to get better signal for an external AP.
InfraBot: Reminder: if you switch to a public network, avoid accessing internal dashboards without VPN.
Luis: showing my age: I just dusted off a powerline adapter and it worked ok for quick web. not great for video but better than nothing.
Noah: who wants me to post a pic of my cable jungle and the one working ethernet snaking to the balcony? :camera_with_flash:
Priya: post please. we live vicariously through each other's chaos.
Zoe: cafe report incoming in 30. free espresso for anyone who braves the line. :racehorse:
Noah: last note: unplug your expensive stuff during lightning. and keep a small travel router in your go-bag. night folks if the storm gets worse.
Priya: night! stay dry.
Luis: stay safe everyone.
Zoe: back in 45 with coffee and a storm diary.
